style_header: Photorealistic full-body photograph of one real person standing, the whole body from head to sandals in frame with a little space around, isolated on a perfectly flat pure chroma-key green background (#00FF00) with no shadow on the background, even soft daylight, sharp focus, natural skin and fabric detail. Kuwait, 1987.
must_not: any text, letters, logos or watermarks

items.prompt: A young Kuwaiti man in a traditional crisp white dishdasha and a white ghutra headscarf held by a black agal cord, cheering with both arms raised high, mouth open shouting, leather sandals.

A young Kuwaiti man in a traditional white dishdasha who has taken his white ghutra off his head and holds it high above his head with one raised arm, swinging it like a flag in celebration, the white cloth flying out to the side; he wears a small white knitted gahfiya cap and the black agal hangs around his neck; shouting with joy.
A Kuwaiti man in a traditional white dishdasha holding his white ghutra above his head with both hands stretched wide, waving it like a banner in support, white gahfiya cap on his head, cheering.
A young Kuwaiti man in a traditional white dishdasha and white ghutra with black agal, filming with a big 1980s shoulder VHS camcorder held to his eye, standing slightly turned.
A Kuwaiti man in his thirties in a traditional white dishdasha and white ghutra with the ends thrown back over his shoulders and a black agal, clapping above his head and laughing.
A young Kuwaiti man in a traditional white dishdasha, his white ghutra twirled in one hand above his head like a propeller, the other fist pumping, white gahfiya cap, excited shout.
A young Kuwaiti man in a traditional beige winter dishdasha and white ghutra with black agal, whistling with two fingers in his mouth, the other hand raised.
An older Kuwaiti man in his fifties with a grey beard in a traditional white dishdasha, white ghutra and black agal, standing with arms crossed and smiling proudly, watching.
